plan.title: Skills panel: one switch per skill with pin and reset, changes pinned on top (project and issue levels)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Below global level the skills panel gives each skill a three-button Inherit | On | Off group and a separate state cell, and the issue view opens on a filter that hides every skill the issue has not touched. A fresh issue shows an almost empty list that reads as read-only and is slow to use.
narratives.Proposal: At project and issue level, replace the Inherit | On | Off group with one switch showing the effective state, a mono source text (on · global, off · this issue, on · pinned here, ...) and one icon button: Pin when the row inherits, Reset when it has a stored value. A pure levelRowState function in SkillControls.tsx owns the six-row state table. Add a Changed for this <level> group listed first with a count, an empty-state line and Reset all (sequential PUTs, stop at first failure, one reload). Every level opens on All; filters become All | Changed here | Off (Off at launch for project); the summary gains `· N changed here`; the live-agent note becomes an amber notice. The three stored states, the server contract, the global level and skill packs are unchanged. The PRD .pan/drafts/pan-5245.md carries the exact code for every item.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server, route or store change: no edit under src/dashboard/server/ or src/lib/ (including src/lib/skill-overrides/), no new endpoint, no batch write, no new polling.
- No change to level="global" rows or behavior (two-state switch stays).
- No change to SkillPacksSection.tsx, SkillPacksSection.test.tsx or SkillOverridesSections.tsx; packs keep Inherit | On | Off and their two-line state cell.
- No change to SkillOverridesPanelProps (PAN-5244 moves the mount point separately).
- No stored 'pinned' flag: pinned is derived from stored value === inherited value.
- No confirmation dialog for Reset all.
- No line-through on off skill names, no 'Show all N' buttons, no neutral 'Saved…' notice, no new search placeholder, no 'Restart agent' button, no change to the launch note text.
- No change to the New conversation dialog's Skills field (features/conversations.mdx, docs/CONTEXT-LAYERS.md).
- No edit to the untracked src/dashboard/frontend/.impeccable/surfaces/ brief.
- No fix for the slow per-issue GET (PAN-5238).
